text:
sarah-sales: Heads up — Prospect (MidBank) wants a POC that uses customer-managed keys (HSM-backed CMKs). They asked for an on-site key workshop + a connectivity test before we sign the SOW. Can we scope effort + cost?

liam-solutions: Got it. Do we know if they want CloudHSM (AWS) or an HSM appliance they bring? That changes latency and network needs.

sarah-sales: They said "HSM as a service" but explicitly need export-protected keys and an attestation report. Also asked for a 30-day rotation policy for dev keys and a monthly rotation for prod.

anika-security: For attestation we can provide firmware attest + HSM vendor certs. Need to confirm FIPS 140-2 level and whether their security folks will accept AWS CloudHSM attestation or require a third-party HSM appliance attestation. Also they want answers for the security questionnaire section: key import process, key lifecycle controls, separation of duties.

mike-ops: Network checklist for the connectivity test: allow outbound to our control plane + HSM endpoint. Minimal firewall rules we ask customers to open: ```
# outbound
TCP 443 -> api.redwood.example.com
TCP 8443 -> <hsm-endpoint>  # vendor specific
UDP 123 -> NTP
```
Also we need to run throughput tests (1000 tps peak tokens) — need a maintenance window if they want to use production HSM.

liam-solutions: Implementation note: Redwood supports BYOK via a KMS proxy. Options: 1) Import wrapped key into CloudHSM (we store only key handle), 2) Use remote KMS proxy to call customer HSM over mTLS. Each has different billing and SLA implications.

jamie-billing: Quick cost flags: HSM endpoints add an ops surcharge (one-time onboarding + ongoing per-hour HSM broker). If they need dedicated throughput we should propose Dedicated capacity pricing instead of hosted. Also attestation and key ceremonies are billable as professional services line items.

sarah-sales: Can you spell out the exact PS line items so I can include in the quote? They asked for an exception to standard 10-day turnaround on key ceremony scheduling (they want 48h).

jamie-billing: Tentative PS lines: "Key workshop (4h)"; "Key import & attestation"; "HSM connectivity validation"; "Rotation automation setup". Estimate: 8-12h engineer time for initial POC, plus one-time $3k onboarding if using BYO appliance. For the 48h scheduling exception, escalate to ops lead — likely charged rush fee.

anika-security: For the questionnaire responses, here's the language we should provide: "Redwood supports HSM-backed customer-managed keys. Keys are zero-export unless explicitly wrapped by the customer's KMS. Attestation artifacts (vendor certificate and signing logs) can be provided. Key rotation can be automated via Redwood Optimize with audit trails available in the Console." Use that exact phrasing and attach the attestation sample once we have vendor certs.

liam-solutions: Can engineering prep a short runbook for the connectivity test we can give to customer network team? I'll draft, but need exact endpoints and cert thumbprints. Also note: if they insist on private peering, need to budget 2–4 weeks for VPN/MPLS provisioning.

mike-ops: I'll attach a minimal verification run (curl + sample token) they can run from their NAT box: ```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/keys/import \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>" \
  -F "wrapped_key=@keywrap.bin" \
  -F "meta={\"purpose\":\"poc\"}"```
We return a key_handle and attestation_url. Test should complete in <30s on normal nets.

sarah-sales: Perfect. Last blocker: acceptance criteria for POC — they need (1) successful key import + attestation, (2) <100ms median single-token latency for inference with HSM-backed keys on our dedicated pool, (3) documented rotation runbook. Can we commit?

liam-solutions: We can commit to import + runbook. Latency target depends on model size and pooling config — we can run a perf matrix during POC and commit to a baseline. Recommend we propose an A/B: Dedicated small GPU pool vs. Hosted with caching.

jamie-billing: I'll add the PS lines and rush fee option into the quote draft. Sarah — want me to include numbers or ranges?

sarah-sales: Include ranges, call out assumptions (CloudHSM vs BYO appliance, peering vs internet), and add the 48h rush fee as optional. I'll schedule the workshop once we confirm calendar and terms. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: POC environment (poc-midbank-331987) created — control plane up, temp API token generated, expires in 7 days.

sarah-sales: Thanks everyone — tagging @liam-solutions for runbook draft and @anika-security for final questionnaire text. I'll send the draft quote to the customer today and propose next Wed for the workshop.
